messages:
emily: Postmortem follow-up: recurring night churn still dominated by 4 alert families. Need owners + small, testable changes. Affected: inference-proxy, scheduler, redis-cache, workers. Snapshot pls @oncall-bot

oncall-bot: 7d snapshot: proxy_conn_spike: 63 alerts, scheduler_backlog: 54 alerts, redis_cache_miss_rate: 29 alerts, worker_restart: 18 alerts. Top services: inference-proxy, batch-scheduler. Link: https://redwood.internal/alerts/7d/1730456789

frank: I'll take proxy_conn_spike. Short fixes: increase proxy upstream CX pool, add connect/backoff jitter, and make alert only page if avg_latency > 200ms. Aim: infra PR Mon.

george: scheduler_backlog looks like load pattern + burst config. I'll add a prefetch throttle + tweak alert to use percentile 95th instead of max. Plan: lab PR Tue, canary Thu.

helen: I'll own redis_cache_miss_rate and worker_restart. For redis: add hot-key histogram, increase read-replica weight, and add dedupe on identical key pattern. For worker_restart: add a death-reason tag to alert and suppress paging for OOM unless restart_count > 2. Target: PRs Wed.

emily: thanks. Couple of constraints: keep dedupe window small (10-20m), prefer signal correlation rather than blanket suppression, and mandate 72h post-rollout monitoring.

frank: agree on 72h. For proxy I'll add a canary with 5% traffic and a dashboard with 1m/5m rolling. Also will add a smoke that emits synthetic connections to validate dedupe. Example smoke:```bash
# smoke: proxy dedupe
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -H "X-Test-Key: dedupe-1" https://proxy-canary.internal/ping; done
# expect: one alert within 15m
```

george: for scheduler I propose changing alert rule from `max(backlog)` to `p95(backlog, 5m) > 1000` and add a suppression when backlog correlates with batch-ingest label `burst=true`.

helen: adding runbook entries now. I'll include exact query strings and a rollback section. Runbook edit link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/alerts/night-churn. Please add PR link when ready.

emily: can we also ensure paging policy adjustments during maintenance windows? e.g., move proxy to page-only-critical 00:00-06:00 for non-prod heavy nights.

frank: yes will set `pager: only-critical` for proxy during 00:00-06:00 for next 72h and monitor. We'll tag alerts with `owner=frank`.

george: also adding a small metric `dedupe_suppressed_total` so we can audit suppression impact.

helen: timeline recap: infra PRs by Wed (frank, helen), scheduler PR by Tue (george). Canary rollouts Thu. 72h monitoring after each rollout. emily to open tracking ticket and add daily check-ins.

emily: opened ticket RI-9921: https://redwood.internal/pm/RI-9921. I'll post a one-line summary each morning. Format: "frank: proxy canary OK | george: scheduler PR open | helen: redis PR merged"

oncall-bot: Reminder set: daily check-in 08:30 UTC until 1730533200 (72h window end).

frank: quick question  do we want dedupe window at 15m or 10m for redis hot keys? leaning 10m to avoid hiding repeated distinct failures.

helen: 10m makes sense for hot-key suppression; keep 15m for connection-level dedupe. We'll document both in runbook.

george: adding automated regression test for scheduler alert change. Mini-spec:```yaml
- name: backlog-alert-smoke
  fire: synthetic-batches burst=true x5
  expect: no page if p95 < 1100
```

emily: thanks everyone. small ask: include a link to the dashboard and the smoke CI when you post PRs so oncall can validate quickly.

frank: will include smoke + dashboard links in PR description.

helen: merged a runbook PR draft, link: https://redwood.internal/prs/2345 (still needs test wiring).

emily: perfect. we'll reconvene if noise doesn't drop after 72h. Closing action owners: frank(proxy), george(scheduler), helen(redis+workers).

(1730456789 thread locked)
